title: Job Roles & Hierarchy
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora conoces la estructura corporativa en inglés, desde los becarios hasta la junta directiva.

parts.visual:
La alta dirección (C-Level): 
- CEO (Chief Executive Officer - Director Ejecutivo). 
- CFO (Chief Financial Officer - Director Financiero). 
- Board of directors (Junta directiva). 
Ej: The CEO reports directly to the board of directors.
parts.audio: Top management, also known as C-Level. CEO stands for Chief Executive Officer. CFO stands for Chief Financial Officer. Board of directors. For example: The CEO reports directly to the board of directors.

parts.visual:
Estructura y responsabilidades: 
- Report to (Reportarse a / Estar bajo el mando de). 
- Be in charge of (Estar a cargo de). 
- Intern (Becario / Pasante). 
Ej: I am a manager. I am in charge of the sales team, and I report to the CEO.
parts.audio: Structure and responsibilities. Report to means who your boss is. Be in charge of means what your responsibility is. An Intern is a student or trainee working to get experience. For example: I am a manager. I am in charge of the sales team, and I report to the CEO.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el rol o término jerárquico correcto.

questions.question: The ____ is the highest-ranking executive in a company. (Director Ejecutivo).
The ____ manages the company's money and financial risks. (Director Financiero).
The CEO must present the annual results to the ____ of directors. (Junta / Consejo).
Who do you ____ to? (¿A quién te reportas? / ¿Quién es tu jefe?).
questions.explanation: Report to = reportarse a (quién es tu supervisor directo).

questions.question: I am in ____ of the marketing department. (A cargo).
questions.explanation: In charge of = a cargo de.

questions.question: He is an ____ at our company for the summer. He is still a university student. (Becario).
After my internship, I hope they offer me a ____ position. (Puesto fijo / Tiempo completo).
questions.explanation: Full-time position = puesto a tiempo completo.

questions.question: The Human ____ department is hiring new staff. (Recursos).
She is the ____ manager. She oversees all operations in Europe. (Regional).
The CTO is the Chief ____ Officer. (Tecnología).
The ____ is responsible for the daily operations of the company. (Director de Operaciones).
We have 500 ____ working in this factory. (Empleados).
My ____ is very strict but fair. (Supervisor / Jefe directo).
questions.explanation: Supervisor o manager = la persona a la que reportas directamente.

questions.question: They are looking for a ____ developer. (Alguien con poca experiencia / Junior).
questions.explanation: Junior = nivel inicial. Senior = nivel avanzado/experimentado.

questions.question: She got a promotion and is now a ____ executive. (Ejecutiva senior / Con experiencia).
The ____ hold the power to change the CEO. (Accionistas).
questions.explanation: Shareholders = accionistas (los dueños de las acciones de la empresa).

questions.question: Who is the ____ of this department? (Jefe / Cabeza).
questions.explanation: Head of department = jefe / director del departamento.

questions.question: I am working as a ____. I am not a permanent employee. (Autónomo / Trabajador independiente).
It's important to build a good relationship with your ____. (Compañeros de trabajo).
questions.explanation: Colleagues o coworkers = compañeros de trabajo.

questions.question: The ____ chain shows who reports to whom. (Cadena de mando).
questions.explanation: Chain of command = cadena de mando.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el cargo o término corporativo correcto.

questions.question: The ____ of directors. (Junta con B)
The Chief Executive Officer. (Acrónimo de 3 letras)
The Chief Financial Officer. (Acrónimo de 3 letras)
Who do you ____ to? (Reportar con R)
I am in ____ of sales. (A cargo con C)
A student worker is an ____. (Becario con I)
Human ____. (Recursos con R plural)
The ____ of the department. (Jefe/Cabeza con H)
Company ____. (Accionistas con S plural)
My ____ are nice. (Compañeros con C plural)
